paragraphs.text: For decades, school meals in many countries were judged mainly by cost. Local authorities chose the cheapest suppliers, and menus were built around foods that could be cooked in large quantities and kept warm for hours.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Complaints from parents and nutritionists began to change this in the early 2000s. Studies showed that many school lunches contained more salt and fat than children needed, while fresh vegetables were rare. Several governments responded by introducing minimum standards for school food.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Standards alone, however, did not guarantee that children would eat the meals. In some schools, the number of pupils choosing school lunches fell after healthier menus were introduced, as many preferred to bring food from home or buy snacks nearby.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: The schools that succeeded tended to involve pupils directly. Children helped to plan menus, tasted new dishes before they were added and, in some cases, grew vegetables in school gardens that were later served in the canteen.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: The design of the dining room also matters. Researchers found that pupils ate more vegetables when these were placed at the start of the serving line, and that shorter queues and quieter rooms made children more likely to finish their food.
paragraphs.label: E

items.quote: school meals in many countries were judged mainly by cost

explanation.en: Paragraph A says price came first: “judged mainly by cost”, “the cheapest suppliers” → iii. Heading i is about expensive healthy food, which the text never mentions.
explanation.kk: A абзацы басты өлшем баға болғаны туралы: «judged mainly by cost», «the cheapest suppliers» → iii. i тақырыбы пайдалы өнімнің қымбаттауы туралы — мәтінде ол жоқ.
explanation.ru: Абзац A о том, что главным была цена: «judged mainly by cost», «the cheapest suppliers» → iii. Заголовок i про дорогие полезные продукты — в тексте об этом нет.

items.quote: Several governments responded by introducing minimum standards for school food

explanation.en: Complaints led to rules: “Complaints … began to change this” and “introducing minimum standards” → v. Heading viii catches “parents”, but in B parents complain rather than cook.
explanation.kk: Ата-аналар мен мамандардың шағымы ережеге әкелген: «Complaints … began to change this» және «introducing minimum standards» → v. viii тақырыбы «parents» сөзіне ілінеді, бірақ B-де ата-аналар тамақ пісірмейді, шағымданады.
explanation.ru: Жалобы родителей и специалистов привели к правилам: «Complaints … began to change this» и «introducing minimum standards» → v. Заголовок viii ловит слово «parents», но родители в B жалуются, а не готовят.

items.quote: the number of pupils choosing school lunches fell after healthier menus were introduced

explanation.en: An unexpected result: after healthier menus “the number of pupils choosing school lunches fell” → vii. “Unexpected” reflects “however” and the fact that standards “did not guarantee” success.
explanation.kk: Күтпеген нәтиже: пайдалы мәзірден кейін «the number of pupils choosing school lunches fell» → vii. «Unexpected» сөзі «however» мен стандарттар табысқа «did not guarantee» дегенді береді.
explanation.ru: Неожиданный результат: после полезных меню «the number of pupils choosing school lunches fell» → vii. «Unexpected» передаёт «however» и то, что стандарты «did not guarantee» успеха.

items.quote: The schools that succeeded tended to involve pupils directly

explanation.en: “The schools that succeeded tended to involve pupils directly” — children planned menus and grew vegetables → ii “Giving children a role in change”.
explanation.kk: «The schools that succeeded tended to involve pupils directly» — балалар мәзір жоспарлап, көкөніс өсірген → ii «Giving children a role in change».
explanation.ru: «The schools that succeeded tended to involve pupils directly» — дети планировали меню и выращивали овощи → ii «Giving children a role in change».

items.quote: The design of the dining room also matters.

explanation.en: Paragraph E is about the dining room: “The design of the dining room also matters”, then vegetable placement, queues and noise → iv. Heading vi mentions restaurants, which are not in the text.
explanation.kk: E абзацының тақырыбы — асхананың жағдайы: «The design of the dining room also matters», әрі қарай көкөністің орны, кезек пен шу туралы → iv. vi тақырыбы мейрамханалар туралы — мәтінде жоқ.
explanation.ru: Тема E — обстановка столовой: «The design of the dining room also matters», дальше про место овощей, очереди и шум → iv. Заголовок vi про рестораны — в тексте их нет.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. The reading passage has five paragraphs, A–E. Choose the correct heading for each paragraph from the list of headings below. Write the correct number, i–viii.
